channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Peninsula Beacon: Dec. 12, 2025
item.description: The Dec. 12, 2025 issue of Peninsula Beacon covers key developments and community moments across Point Loma and Ocean Beach.

item.title: Mission Times Courier: Dec. 12, 2025
item.description: The Dec. 12, 2025–Jan. 15, 2026 issue of Mission Times Courier highlights community stories across Allied Gardens, Del Cerro and more.

item.title: DUI checkpoints planned Friday and Saturday as holiday enforcement begins
item.description: La Mesa Police and the San Diego Sheriff announced Friday and Saturday night DUI checkpoints as holiday drunk driving enforcement ramps up.

item.title: Gas prices keep falling in San Diego, but not as fast as the rest of the country
item.description: Gas prices are falling in San Diego, but drivers here still pay more than in cheaper parts of the country.

item.title: Sobremesa marks shift for owner, with new focus on Latin American cuisine
item.description: The Lake Murray restaurant is owned by the same family behind Aromi Italian Cuisine in La Mesa and Trattoria Da Sofia in Kensington.

item.title: La Mesa’s Mansour battles back, returns to boxing ring after blow of losing mom
item.description: In five fights since his debut, Mansour has either won with shutout decisions or scored knockouts. He will work to keep the streak going Saturday.

item.title: Local Afghans wary, ‘in shock’ amid Trump crackdown after National Guard shooting
item.description: The Trump administration ordered immigration restrictions for immigrants from Afghanistan and more after the D.C. National Guard shooting.

item.title: Ex-GirlsDoPorn bookkeeper sentenced to prison in sex trafficking case
item.description: Valorie Moser is one of the last defendants to be sentenced in the long-running prosecution against the one-time San Diego website's operators.

item.title: Five questions with Ed Stasium: The Ramones and Talking Heads producer who landed in Poway
item.description: Ed Stasium, the famed New York producer who worked with bands from Gladys Knight & the Pips to Living Colour, is still going strong — but now its from his Poway home studio.

item.title: City, county to pay $10 million each in large settlement following Spring Valley girl’s death
item.description: A lawsuit was brought on behalf of Arabella McCormack's younger sisters. The three Spring Valley girls were allegedly abused by family.
